comment: B3 — composite (cell, subject) state-key encoding determinism. Spec authority: conformance/encoding.md §9.5 (state_subject = base64url_nopad(sha256(canonical_json(components_array))). The state_subject hash is canonical and kind-independent. Every vector uses current v1 `ak.*` kinds and typed ids.

encoder.canonical_json: RFC 8785 / encoding.md §1: arrays preserve order, object keys sorted, no whitespace
encoder.ordering_property: components_array ordering is deterministic per kind; reordering produces a different hash

ordering_negative_vectors.name: wrong_component_order_must_differ
ordering_negative_vectors.comment: Component reordering (actor_id before realm_id) MUST produce a different hash than the canonical order. Encoders that emit canonical state_subject by reordering would diverge from realm_member_carol.

ordering_negative_vectors.name: wrong_component_order_must_differ_realm_policy
ordering_negative_vectors.comment: Second ordering negative on a different kind: policy_name before realm_id MUST NOT collide with realm_policy_default's canonical subject.
